definitions.explanation: chewing gum specifically designed for blowing bubbles, softer and more elastic than regular gum

examples.japanese: {風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませた→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧。
examples.english: I blew a bubble with bubble gum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{泡|あわ}→泡：02175_awa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: The child is making a big bubble with bubble gum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}→授業中：20544_jugyouchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}んでいて→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{叱|しか}られた→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧。
examples.english: I was chewing bubble gum during class and got scolded by the teacher.

notes:
Refers to the type of chewing gum that can be blown into bubbles. In Japan, bubble gum is popular with children and is sold in both ball-shaped and stick forms. The word combines ⟦{風船|ふうせん}→風船：14623_fuusen⟧ (balloon) and ⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧ (gum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to chew bubble gum
- {風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to blow a bubble
- {風船|ふうせん}ガム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{割|わ}れる→割れる：00907_wareru⟧: the bubble pops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧: pellet gum — small coated gum pieces, not specifically for blowing bubbles
- ⟦{板|いた}ガム→板ガム：18366_itagamu⟧: stick gum — flat rectangular pieces of chewing gum
- ⟦チューインガム→チューインガム：24996_chuuingamu⟧: chewing gum — the general term for gum
